items.review: Switching between casino games and sport takes a single touch from the top bar, which matches how I like to play.
Each promotion has its own card on the offers page, complete with the conditions I need to read.
Buttons are chunky enough for my thumbs, and the account panel sits exactly where I expect it on a small screen.
The support agents answered in English and stayed patient when I came back with a follow-up question.
I registered from my handset and the confirmation message landed in my inbox straight away.
Browsing by game category is quick, and the big developers' titles are simple to locate in the lobby.
